findings.issue: The refuse/return row lost 'at the state the rule names' when the status code was substituted.
Section 9 was aligned to LOV codes under R-00138 to R-00144, yet this says it cannot be. The From column still used the old labels.
Header row says only EV-09 and EV-08 are published and no ApprovalDecided, but the story publishes nothing and consumes ApprovalDecided.v1.
The missing ApprovalDecided catalogue row belongs to the event catalogue, not this story.
AC16 expects exactly one decision record, but routing, escalation and outcome each write records, so a redelivery test could fail wrongly.
AC15 overlaps the log-failure case in AC4, and section 8 names only AC4 for BR12. AC15 is kept for numbering and the overlap is recorded.
X4, X5, X7 and X8 showed no criterion, though section 16 maps their test cases to AC8, AC10, AC12 and AC13.
Note says the event name fix was not applied, but it is applied in sections 12.4 and 13.
Note says the owner story is not named, but the rows name RWB-P7-E2013-APP.
Note says the Empty state cites CG-ALL-645, but only Error and No access do.
